structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son or my own bank. The page only lists names with small words about what they sell, and it doesn't say who is cheaper or safer. The one useful thing I saw is that my bank appears under "בנקים ובתי השקעות נוספים" with a "תעריפון" date, but I didn't open it.
